map.心脏彩超(LVEF/室壁运动)报告解读器 使用指南: Echocardiography (LVEF/wall motion) report interpreter - User Guide
map.输入超声心动图关键参数，自动评估收缩功能、室壁运动、心腔大小及舒张功能: Enter key echocardiography parameters to auto-assess systolic function, wall motion, chamber size and diastolic function
map.LVEF 分级解读：左室射血分数 ≥55% 正常、40%–54% 轻度下降、<4: LVEF grading: left ventricular ejection fraction >=55% normal, 40%-54% mildly reduced, <40% reduced (heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, HFrEF); judge with volumes.
map.节段室壁运动评分：按 17 节段评估运动（正常/运动减弱/无运动/矛盾/室壁瘤）: Segmental wall-motion scoring: assess motion per 17 segments (normal/hypokinetic/akinetic/dyskinetic/aneurysm); higher total means larger ischemia/infarction extent.
map.舒张功能评估：以 E/e'、左房大小、TR 速度等判定舒张功能障碍分级，辅助 H: Diastolic function assessment: grade diastolic dysfunction by E/e', left-atrial size, TR velocity, etc., aiding HFpEF diagnosis and filling-pressure estimation.
map.：输入：LVEF 38%、左室舒张末径 58 mm、E/e' 15、左房前后径: : input: LVEF 38%, LVEDD 58 mm, E/e' 15, LA diameter 42 mm, segment score 27 (17 segments). Tool output: systolic function reduced (HFrEF), diastolic function possibly grade II-III, note dilated change with elevated filling pressure, suggestion combine BNP/clinical workup for heart-failure etiology. Note: values are measured by the sonographer; this tool only assists grading.
map.一般 <40% 为射血分数降低（HFrEF），41%–49% 为轻度降低，≥50: Generally <40% is reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), 41%-49% mildly reduced, >=50% with symptoms and elevated filling pressure is preserved type (HFpEF). LVEF is affected by load and measurement; combine with volumes and clinical context.
map.室壁运动评分有何用？: What is the use of wall-motion scoring?
map.把左室分为 17 节段逐一打分，总分换算为室壁运动指数（WMSI），可定位缺血/: Divide the left ventricle into 17 segments and score each; the total converts to the wall-motion score index (WMSI), localizing ischemia/infarction and assessing extent and revascularization value; abnormal segment motion also needs angiography or MRI.
map.不能。超声是结构与功能首选，但冠脉、心肌存活、血栓等需 CTA/造影/磁共振等补: No. Ultrasound is the first choice for structure and function, but coronary arteries, myocardial viability and thrombus need CTA/angiography/MRI supplements; report interpretation should combine symptoms, BNP and ECG for an integrated cardiology judgement.
